SELECT term.id AS termId, term.term_name AS termName, sd.id AS sessionId, sd.start_time AS startTime, sd.end_time AS endTime, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, (SELECT g.grade_name FROM t_as_enrollment enr INNER JOIN t_as_student stu ON enr.student_id = stu.id LEFT JOIN t_educl_grade g ON stu.grade_id = g.id and g.is_valid = 1 WHERE enr.course_class_id = cc.id AND enr.is_valid = 1 AND stu.is_valid = 1 AND stu.grade_id IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1) AS gradeName, sd.place_name AS placeName, sd.session_date AS sessionDate FROM t_as_course_session sd INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON sd.course_class_id = cc.id INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_educl_term term ON svc.term_id = term.id AND term.is_valid = 1
sd.is_valid = 1 AND cc.is_valid = 1 AND sd.school_id = #{query.schoolId} AND sd.teacher_id = #{teacherId} AND svc.term_id = #{query.termId} AND DATE_FORMAT(sd.session_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{today} AND sd.session_status IN (0, 1, 2)
ORDER BY sd.start_time ASC

SELECT term.id AS termId, term.term_name AS termName, sd.id AS sessionId, sd.start_time AS startTime, sd.end_time AS endTime, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, g.grade_name AS gradeName, sd.place_name AS placeName, sd.session_date AS sessionDate FROM t_as_student_destination dest INNER JOIN t_as_course_session sd ON dest.session_id = sd.id INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON sd.course_class_id = cc.id INNER JOIN t_as_service ser ON cc.service_id = ser.id AND ser.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_educl_term term ON ser.term_id = term.id AND term.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_enrollment ae ON sd.id = ae.session_id and dest.student_id = ae.student_id and ae.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_teacher t ON sd.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_as_student stu ON dest.student_id = stu.id LEFT JOIN t_educl_grade g ON stu.grade_id = g.id and g.is_valid = 1
dest.is_valid = 1 AND sd.is_valid = 1 AND cc.is_valid = 1 AND t.is_valid = 1 AND stu.is_valid = 1 and stu.register_status = 1 and ae.enroll_status in(1,3) AND dest.school_id = #{query.schoolId} AND dest.student_id = #{studentId} AND stu.term_id = ser.term_id AND ser.term_id = #{query.termId} AND dest.destination_type = 1 AND DATE_FORMAT(sd.session_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{today} AND sd.session_status IN (0, 1, 2)
ORDER BY sd.start_time ASC

SELECT term.id AS termId, term.term_name AS termName, sd.id AS sessionId, sd.start_time AS startTime, sd.end_time AS endTime, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, t.teacher_name AS teacherName, g.grade_name AS gradeName, sd.place_name AS placeName, sd.session_date AS sessionDate, cc.id AS courseClassId, sd.teacher_id AS teacherId, cc.enroll_type AS enrollType, CASE cc.enroll_type WHEN 1 THEN '公开报名' WHEN 2 THEN '邀请报名' WHEN 3 THEN '行政班安排' END AS enrollTypeName, cat.category_name AS categoryName FROM t_as_student_destination dest INNER JOIN t_as_course_session sd ON dest.session_id = sd.id INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON sd.course_class_id = cc.id INNER JOIN t_as_service ser ON cc.service_id = ser.id AND ser.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_educl_term term ON ser.term_id = term.id AND term.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_teacher t ON sd.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN t_as_student stu ON dest.student_id = stu.id LEFT JOIN t_educl_grade g ON stu.grade_id = g.id and g.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_course_category cat ON cc.category_id = cat.id and cat.is_valid = 1
dest.is_valid = 1 AND sd.is_valid = 1 AND cc.is_valid = 1 AND t.is_valid = 1 AND stu.is_valid = 1 AND dest.school_id = #{schoolId} AND dest.student_id = #{studentId} AND stu.term_id = ser.term_id AND sd.id = #{sessionId} AND dest.destination_type = 1
AND DATE_FORMAT(sd.session_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{today}
AND sd.session_status IN (0, 1, 2)
ORDER BY sd.start_time ASC

SELECT sd.id AS sessionId, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, sd.session_date AS sessionDate, sd.start_time, sd.end_time FROM t_as_student_destination dest INNER JOIN t_as_course_session sd ON dest.session_id = sd.id INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON sd.course_class_id = cc.id INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_educl_term term ON svc.term_id = term.id AND term.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_student stu ON dest.student_id = stu.id AND stu.is_valid = 1 AND stu.term_id = svc.term_id INNER JOIN t_as_enrollment ae ON sd.id = ae.session_id and dest.student_id = ae.student_id and ae.is_valid = 1
dest.is_valid = 1 AND sd.is_valid = 1 AND cc.is_valid = 1 and ae.enroll_status in(1,3) AND dest.student_id = #{studentId} AND sd.school_id = #{query.schoolId} AND svc.term_id = #{query.termId} AND dest.destination_type = 1 AND sd.session_start_date > NOW()
AND sd.session_start_date <= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.sessionEndDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AND sd.session_end_date >= DATE_FORMAT(#{query.sessionStartDate}, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i')
ORDER BY sd.session_date DESC

SELECT sd.id AS sessionId, CONCAT(DATE_FORMAT(sd.start_time, '%H:%i'), '-', DATE_FORMAT(sd.end_time, '%H:%i')) AS classTime FROM t_as_course_session sd WHERE sd.is_valid = 1 AND sd.course_class_id = #{courseClassId} AND DATE_FORMAT(sd.session_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{today} AND sd.session_status IN (0, 1, 2) ORDER BY sd.start_time ASC

SELECT cs.school_id, cs.id AS session_id, sp.start_time, sp.end_time FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_schedule_period sp ON cs.schedule_period_id = sp.id AND sp.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.is_valid = 1 AND cs.schedule_period_id IS NOT NULL AND cs.is_operate_attend = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(cs.session_date, '%Y-%m-%d') = #{today} ORDER BY sp.start_time ASC

SELECT stu.student_name, cc.course_class_name, sp.start_time, sp.end_time, t.user_id teacherUserId FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_schedule_period sp ON cs.schedule_period_id = sp.id AND sp.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_student stu ON stu.id = #{studentId} AND stu.is_valid = 1 and stu.register_status = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_class ec ON ec.id = stu.class_id AND ec.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_teacher t ON t.id = ec.head_teacher_id AND t.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.id = #{sessionId} AND cs.is_valid = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT cs.id AS sessionId, s.id AS studentId, s.student_name, s.student_no, cs.session_date, DATE_FORMAT(cs.start_time, '%H:%i') AS startTime, DATE_FORMAT(cs.end_time, '%H:%i') AS endTime, sd.destination_type AS destinationType, t.user_id AS headTeacherUserId, cc.course_class_name AS courseClassName, cs.teacher_id AS teacherId FROM t_as_student_destination sd INNER JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON sd.session_id = cs.id AND cs.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_student s ON sd.student_id = s.id AND s.is_valid = 1 and s.register_status = 1 LEFT JOIN t_educl_class ec ON ec.id = s.class_id AND ec.is_valid = 1 LEFT JOIN t_as_teacher t ON t.id = ec.head_teacher_id AND t.is_valid = 1 WHERE sd.session_id = #{sessionId} AND sd.is_valid = 1 and s.register_status = 1 AND sd.destination_type = 1

SELECT term.id AS termId, term.term_name AS termName, stu.id AS studentId, stu.student_name AS studentName, stu.student_no AS studentNo FROM t_as_student_destination sd INNER JOIN t_as_course_session cs ON sd.session_id = cs.id AND cs.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_service svc ON cc.service_id = svc.id AND svc.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_educl_term term ON svc.term_id = term.id AND term.is_valid = 1 INNER JOIN t_as_student stu ON sd.student_id = stu.id AND stu.is_valid = 1 WHERE sd.session_id = #{sessionId} AND sd.is_valid = 1 AND sd.destination_type = 1 AND stu.term_id = svc.term_id and stu.register_status = 1 ORDER BY stu.student_no ASC

SELECT cc.course_class_name FROM t_as_course_session cs INNER JOIN t_as_course_class cc ON cs.course_class_id = cc.id AND cc.is_valid = 1 WHERE cs.id = #{sessionId} AND cs.school_id = #{schoolId} AND cs.is_valid = 1 LIMIT 1
